title: MALDI-TOF MS Preparation for Identification of Mosquitoes
author: Andrea L. Lawrence
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vnee5be

steps.title: Prepare Matrix Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the matrix solution using α-cyano-4-hydroxycinnamic acid and solvents.

substeps.instruction: Add approximately 50 µL of α-cyano-4-hydroxycinnamic acid matrix powder to an Eppendorf tube and immediately return stock powder to the fridge.
Add 500 µL of 100% ACN (acetonitrile), 475 µL of HPLC grade water, and 25 µL of 100% trifluoroacetic acid to the tube.
Homogenize the solution in an ultrasonic bath for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge the solution for 10 minutes at 13,000 rpm (20,784 x g).
Retrieve the supernatant using a pipette, avoiding the powder, and discard the powder.

steps.title: Prepare Mosquito Specimens
steps.instruction: Prepare and dissect mosquito legs for analysis.

substeps.instruction: If using live mosquitoes, freeze at -20 °C for at least 1 minute prior to dissection.
Using two sets of forceps (one to steady the specimen, one to remove legs), carefully remove the legs and place them at the bottom of a labeled, sterile Eppendorf tube.
Decontaminate forceps with 70% ethanol between different species.

steps.title: Extract Protein from Legs
steps.instruction: Process the mosquito legs to extract proteins using chemical lysis and mechanical crushing.

substeps.instruction: Spin down the legs for 1 minute at 13,000 rpm (20,784 x g).
Add 15 µL of 50% CAN and 15 µL of 70% formic acid to each tube.
Add acid-washed glass beads (<106um) until the volume of beads is just less than half the volume of the liquid.
Place tubes in TissueLyser II (Qiagen) canisters, ensuring both tubes and canisters are balanced (heavy sides either both facing inward or both outward).
Crush the legs using a cycle of 3 x 1 minute at 30 Hz, allowing the sample to rest for approximately 15 seconds between each minute.

steps.title: Load Plate for MALDI-TOF MS
steps.instruction: Apply samples and matrix to the MALDI plate.

substeps.instruction: Load 1 µL of each sample onto the plate in quadruplicate, staying within the spots.
Load 1 µL of matrix solution over the sample and allow to dry completely.

steps.title: Store and Launch Plate
steps.instruction: Store the prepared plate correctly before analysis.

substeps.instruction: Place the plate in a cool, dark place.
Note: Plates can be kept for a maximum of 2-3 days at room temperature in the dark before spectra are affected (longer for simple identification).
